note: Development-only and below-TQQQ research, kept for completeness. These are not part of the one-winner-per-family above-TQQQ set.

strategies.name: Overnight + intraday trend
strategies.tagline: A 20/50-session trend holds the overnight, while a 0.6% intraday stop cuts the session's left tail.
strategies.summary: Starts each session long TQQQ when the 20/50 trend or a 50-day reclaim is intact, exits intraday on a 0.6% QQQ decline, re-enters on a reclaim, and skips the night if stopped and not reclaimed. Dev CAGR is 64.63%, but it fails at 10 bp (33.84%) and it is dev-only.
strategies.note: It fails at 10 bp (33.84%), and the max drawdown is a 2019 whipsaw rather than a crash; it is dev-only.

strategies.name: Fast-drawdown brake
strategies.tagline: Defaults to TQQQ, exits on a 14% five-session loss, and re-enters on a 15-session high.
strategies.summary: A fast crash exit paired with a deliberately slow re-entry: the 15-day high is what avoids bear-market rallies and catches the durable leg of a V recovery. Dev CAGR is 52.83%, but the exit alone sells into bounces and the worst drawdown is a 2018 whipsaw.
strategies.note: The exit alone sells into bounces; the 15-session re-entry is what carries the dev-only result, and the worst drawdown is a 2018 whipsaw.

strategies.name: SPY-confirmed trend
strategies.tagline: A QQQ 150-day trend ladder that requires SPY above its 200-day SMA before using 3x leverage.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ only when both QQQ and SPY are above trend, QQQ when only QQQ is, and BIL otherwise, with an 85% vol target and a -15% from-20-day-high brake. Dev CAGR is 50.36%, but the literal mandate centre (100-day QQQ, -10% brake) fails at 20.64%, and it is dev-only.
strategies.note: The literal mandate centre (100-day QQQ, -10% brake) fails at 20.64%; the pass needs the 150-day/-15% variant and has no holdout.

strategies.name: Dual-momentum TQQQ
strategies.tagline: A 12-month QQQ-vs-cash and QQQ-vs-SPY gate on a volatility-targeted TQQQ sleeve.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ when absolute and relative momentum agree, QQQ when only absolute momentum is positive, and BIL otherwise. It clears development at 41.15%, but the 252-session lookback is load-bearing, the placebo misses its threshold, and 2018 is a full TQQQ drawdown.
strategies.note: The 252-session lookback is load-bearing (126/189 fail), the placebo misses its 10% threshold, and the 2018 drawdown is a full TQQQ drawdown.

strategies.name: Aggressive vol target
strategies.tagline: Always-long TQQQ at an 80-100% vol target with a linear 6-12% drawdown brake.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ permanently, scaling by min(1, target/RV20) and cutting to a 25% floor as the 15-day drawdown widens from 6% to 12%. Dev CAGR is 40.16%, but it underperforms TQQQ in every bull year and needs 30.51% holdout CAGR to clear the full bar.
strategies.note: It underperforms TQQQ in every bull year and needs 30.51% holdout CAGR to clear the full bar; it is dev-only.

strategies.name: Always-long vol target
strategies.tagline: Holds TQQQ permanently and scales the position only by its own realised volatility.
strategies.summary: A pure volatility-target test with no trend, drawdown or crash gate: TQQQ weight is min(1, target/RV20). The 45% target clears the development bar but the frozen full run reaches 37.25% CAGR, 0.29 pp below TQQQ; the 50% variant that hit 37.95% failed the pre-cut weight test.
strategies.note: The frozen RV20/45 rerun reaches only 37.25% full CAGR, 0.29 pp below the bar; the 50% variant that reached 37.95% failed the pre-cut weight test.

strategies.name: FOMC intermeeting drift
strategies.tagline: Holds TQQQ only from the third to the twentieth session after each scheduled FOMC decision.
strategies.summary: The claim is that the equity premium is earned in the middle of the FOMC cycle, after the two-day post-decision unwind and before the next meeting's de-risking. It passes development at 51.06%, but the full 37.09% misses the bar by 0.45 pp and ex-2020 CAGR is about 33.4%.
strategies.note: Ex-2020 CAGR is about 33.4%, below the bar, and the full 37.09% misses 37.54% by 0.45 pp.

strategies.name: Overnight drift filter
strategies.tagline: A close-anchored TQQQ position sized by 10-day vol and halved below the 20-day SMA.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ through the overnight block and the next session, scaling to min(1, 0.20/vol) and halving exposure when QQQ is below its 20-day average. The full 37.07% CAGR misses the bar by 0.47 pp, and the 2022 drawdown is 58.35%.
strategies.note: Full CAGR is 37.07%, 0.47 pp short of the bar; the 2022 drawdown is 58.35% and the holdout earns 20.90%.

strategies.name: Momentum + crash brake
strategies.tagline: A loose 20/60-session momentum gate with an explicit fast-drawdown crash brake and a 5-day-high re-entry.
strategies.summary: Holds TQQQ while either momentum horizon is positive, overrides to cash on a fast 20-day drawdown plus a vol-spike or 3-day-loss confirmation, and re-enters on a 5-day high with positive 20-day momentum. It wins 2020 and 2022 and loses every other year; the full 35.61% misses the bar.
strategies.note: The edge is crash avoidance (wins 2020 and 2022, loses every other year); the holdout earns 20.10% and the full 35.61% misses the bar.

strategies.name: Donchian two-sleeve trend
strategies.tagline: A fast 20/10 TQQQ Donchian sleeve plus a slow 100/50 QQQ regime sleeve, sized to an 85% vol target.
strategies.summary: The fast sleeve re-enters quickly after shakeouts while the slow QQQ regime keeps the book invested through multi-month trends. It passes development at 49.14% CAGR, but the 50-session slow exit is load-bearing and the 2024-26 holdout earns only 3.19%.
strategies.note: The slow 50-session exit is load-bearing and the 2024-26 holdout earns only 3.19% CAGR.

strategies.name: Turn-of-month
strategies.tagline: Holds TQQQ in the last five and first six sessions of each month.
strategies.summary: A pure calendar tilt around the month boundary, with no trend or price signal and BIL outside the window. Dev CAGR is 41.41% and full is 33.62%; the 11-session window is wide and the holdout earns only 16.00%.
strategies.note: The 2016-26 full CAGR is 33.62% and the holdout 16.00%; the 11-session window is wide and the edge is not a clean turn-of-month effect.

strategies.name: Quiet capitulation reversal
strategies.tagline: Buys TQQQ after a quiet multi-horizon QQQ decline and holds one session.
strategies.summary: Triggers on a -3% 3-session, -5% 10-session or -8% 15-session QQQ decline on below-average volume, then buys TQQQ at the event close for one session. The 1 bp development result is 39.75% CAGR, but it fails at 5 bp and the 2024-26 holdout earns only 13.02%.
strategies.note: The 1 bp pass does not survive 5 bp (34.67%), and the holdout collapses to 13.02% CAGR.

strategies.name: Close-momentum weakness exit
strategies.tagline: A vol-targeted TQQQ core that goes to cash for 24 hours after a negative full intraday return in an elevated-vol tape.
strategies.summary: The return engine is continuous vol-targeted TQQQ; a negative QQQ open-to-close return while 10-day vol is at least 20% triggers a one-day cash exit. Dev CAGR is 46.21%, but the holdout is flat at 0.00% daily and the full 31.21% is entirely a 2016-2023 phenomenon.
strategies.note: The holdout is flat at 0.00% daily (1 bp -1.41%), so the 31.21% full CAGR is entirely a 2016-2023 phenomenon.

strategies.name: Cross-asset dual momentum
strategies.tagline: Rotates TQQQ, QQQ and BIL on multi-horizon QQQ-vs-cash and QQQ-vs-SPY momentum.
strategies.summary: Uses a 21/42-session absolute-momentum OR gate and a 42-session QQQ/SPY relative gate, with a volatility-targeted TQQQ sleeve. Revision 1 failed and Revision 2 was built after that failure; the full 30.58% CAGR and 9.23% holdout make it a fragile 2018/2022 avoidance bet.
strategies.note: Revision 2 was built after Revision 1 failed, and the holdout earns only 9.23% CAGR; the edge is a fragile 2018/2022 avoidance bet.

strategies.name: Opening-range breakout
strategies.tagline: A TQQQ opening-range breakout confirmed by volume and ATR, flat every night.
strategies.summary: Buys a gap-up opening-range breakout when opening volume is in a normal-to-expanded band and the range is a small fraction of ATR, with an ATR-scaled stop and a close exit. Dev CAGR is only 17.89% at 1 bp (11.33% at 5 bp), far below the bar, so the idea is retained as a negative result.
strategies.note: Dev-only and far below the bar at 17.89% CAGR; the edge also decays to 11.33% at 5 bp.

strategies.name: Pre-holiday drift
strategies.tagline: Holds TQQQ for the three sessions before every scheduled NYSE holiday.
strategies.summary: Tests the classic pre-holiday effect in a 3x fund, with a vol throttle that halves TQQQ above the trailing 75th percentile. The window is statistically indistinguishable from random (t=0.52), the best grid cell is 15.5 CAGR points short, and the result is 4.23% dev.
strategies.note: The pre-holiday window is indistinguishable from a random window (t=0.52) and the best grid cell is 15.5 CAGR points short of the bar.
